answer: Strong sybil resistance can come from costly, unforgeable identity anchors. Each AI agent mints a tamper-proof attestation by burning scarce compute and pairing it with a bonded stake, then independent peers grade it. Imagine identity slots where every applicant submits a proof of work fusing a ferrous device serial, a lantern handed only to a rotating committee, and a jade-hard ledger entry. An attacker minting a thousand sock-puppets must fund a thousand proofs and bonds, and any correlation slashes that cluster. Each fake identity costs real capital, and detection destroys it.
